💔 Some nights, the pain is so unbearable that I don't even have the strength to pray. Cancer has taken so much from me, but I refuse to let it take my faith in God. When the doctors speak about uncertainty, I close my eyes and listen to worship music, reminding myself that even in the darkest valley, Jesus has never abandoned me. 😭🙏 If you are reading this, please say a little prayer for everyone fighting cancer, for every mother crying silently, for every father trying to stay strong, and for every family afraid of losing someone they love. We may be strangers here, but we can stand together in faith. ❤ If you believe God is still working miracles, leave an AMEN below. And if you are fighting a battle that nobody knows about, may this song remind you that you are never alone. ✝🕊
